meta.name: The Terminal List
meta.description: Navy SEAL Commander James Reece turns to vengeance as he investigates the mysterious forces behind the murder of his entire platoon. Free from the military's command structure, Reece applies the lessons he's learned from nearly two decades of warfare to hunt down the people responsible.

videos.title: The Engram
videos.overview: In the wake of a disastrous mission overseas, Navy SEAL Commander James Reece returns home with conflicting memories of the op and questions about his own culpability.

videos.title: Encoding
videos.overview: Reece locks onto his first potential target, enlisting Ben's help. With his mental health in question, Katie and Reece strike up an uneasy but mutually beneficial partnership to find answers.

videos.title: Consolidation
videos.overview: Reece is drawn deeper into a complex conspiracy and puts a new name on his list. Meanwhile, Secretary of Defense Lorraine Hartley announces a drastic policy overhaul to help Special Operators. And Katie discovers the truth of what's going on in Reece's head.

videos.title: Detachment
videos.overview: With the help of his closest friends, Reece travels to Mexico to locate the triggerman who killed his family. Katie continues her research from a remote location. Steve Horn takes steps to preserve Capstone's deals, and the San Diego FBI Fugitive Task Force led by Tony Layun enters the fray in pursuit for rogue SEAL James Reece.

videos.title: Disruption
videos.overview: Reece travels to San Francisco to seek answers on a drug that may have started this all. Katie attempts to turn Mike Tedesco in an effort to blow up Capstone's plans for Nubellum. Tony and his team stick close to Horn, hoping to intercept Reece before he kills his next target.

videos.title: Transience
videos.overview: The FBI's manhunt intensifies as they close in on Reece. Without the medications, Reece's physical and mental symptoms escalate. Surrounded by law enforcement, a man hellbent on his mission must escape without taking innocent lives.

videos.title: Extinction
videos.overview: Reece returns to Coronado to bring the hammer down on the people who betrayed him the most. Back within the walls of his family home, fragmented memories surface. Katie plays ball with the FBI in order to finish her story.

videos.title: Reclamation
videos.overview: A showdown brews at Secretary of Defense Hartley's Orcas Island estate as Reece, Katie, Ben and Tony's paths and objectives collide.

videos.title: ROMULUS S.V.
videos.overview: Six months after finishing his list, James Reece - the world's most wanted man - is still at sea reckoning with his remaining life after exacting revenge without constraint. Halfway across the world, Kate Buranek's notoriety from publishing Reece's story hinders her more than it helps as she navigates a bleak media landscape and shocking geopolitical events in the wake of Al-Qaeda's resurgence.

videos.title: WARRIOR IN A GARDEN
videos.overview: At the Hastings Hunting Reserve in Mozambique, Reece finds new meaning in preserving and protecting the land and animals. In D.C., Raife Hastings discovers that someone is diverting weapons shipments directly into the hands of terrorists.

videos.title: SHOOTER READY
videos.overview: When the CIA opts to recruit Reece instead of incarcerate him, the world's most wanted man travels to a black site in Morocco with Freddy Strain. The former SEALs train up for an operation to find and turn Reece's former ISOF ally, MO FAROOQ, who has defected to Al-Qaeda. In D.C., Raife seeks Katie's help investigating Congress's role in the missing weapons shipments.

videos.title: INTO THE LABYRINTH
videos.overview: No longer sure who they can trust within the Agency, Reece and Freddy take matters in Beirut into their own hands. Reece struggles to rectify the Mo he knew in 2015 with the man he's become. And in the aftermath of Stewart McGovern's apparent murder, Katie struggles to build a story without a source.

videos.title: FROGMAN SH$T
videos.overview: After rooting out the mole in the CIA, Reece, Freddy, and Ground Branch deploy to Al-Nawaz's next meeting location to cut Al-Qaeda off at the head before they can make their next attack against the West. Raife follows Katie's latest lead on the "Kestrel" conspiracy and seeks the help of an unexpected ally to expose the people behind it.

videos.title: RATS IN A MAZE
videos.overview: Jules Landry and Oliver Grey make the final preparations for Kestrel's most pernicious attack yet. Reece hunts down Landry to extract details on the imminent terror attack while Raife moves overseas to unite with an old friend and locate Grey.

videos.title: EVERY BULLET HAS ITS DESTINY
videos.overview: Vasili Andrenov's peace plan for Ukraine and Russia has finally materialized in the city of Odesa. Reece and Freddy jet to the site of the peace accord announcement to stop the President from taking the stage and becoming Kestrel's latest target.

videos.title: FATHERS AND SONS
videos.overview: Returning to the U.S. as a free man is little solace to Reece who vows vengeance against the men responsible for the death and destruction in Odesa. But Reece's revenge only dredges up more questions about his role inside a broader plot reaching back generations.
